title: Healthy Eating & Clean Hands
subject: Integrated Studies
description: Eat from all the food groups and keep those hands clean!
steps: Healthy food gives your body energy to grow, learn, and play.
Eat from the food groups every day: fruits 🍌, vegetables 🥕, grains 🍚, proteins 🍗, and dairy 🥛.
Jamaica grows wonderful healthy foods — mangoes, ackee, callaloo, bananas, and yams!
Wash your hands with soap and water before eating and after using the bathroom — sing the ABC song while you scrub!
